name: Reconnect
source:
You're on your way to take a break from daily life. As you journey along, you come across an old friend and start to reconnect with one another. But as the days go on, you start to realize there's something more that's she's hiding.

[From [url=https://kingslayer77.itch.io/reconnect]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你踏上旅途，想暂时从日常生活中抽身。途中，你遇见一位老朋友，两人逐渐重新熟络。然而，随着日子过去，你开始察觉，她还隐藏着什么。

[摘自[url=https://kingslayer77.itch.io/reconnect]Itch.io[/url]]
